Steve Toth

Republican candidate for U.S. Representative, District 2, Harris County, Texas · Open seat

Business owner (Acclaim Pools, My PoolXpert); pastor; Texas state representative, District 15

Steve Toth is a Republican Texas state representative for House District 15 in The Woodlands area. He has held that seat since 2019 and also held it from 2013 to 2015. He won the Republican nomination for Texas' 2nd Congressional District by defeating incumbent U.S. Rep. Dan Crenshaw, Martin Etwop and Nicholas Plumb in the March 3, 2026 primary, and he faces Democrat Shaun Finnie in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Where Toth stands

Energy
Supports expanding domestic oil and gas production so the U.S. never depends on foreign nations for fuel. He says energy security starts in Texas.
Energy permitting
Wants to reform energy permitting.
Border security and immigration
Lists securing the southern border as a top priority. He says he will push Congress to act against human traffickers, cartels and criminals trying to cross the border.
Flooding
Says little has changed in flood protection despite federal flood-control money coming to Harris County, and argues Kingwood is as vulnerable as it was during Hurricane Harvey.
Foreign policy and defense
Says he will work with President Trump on 'peace through strength,' defend allies such as Israel, and make sure money spent abroad serves American interests.
Veterans
Pledges to support veterans' mental health, housing and job opportunities.
Gender-affirming care for minors
Proposes cutting off funding for hospitals that perform gender-affirming procedures on minors.
Education
Lists 'Educating Future Generations' among his campaign priorities. He says he led Texas House efforts to remove Critical Race Theory and DEI from public schools and universities.
Gun rights
Lists defending the Second Amendment among his campaign priorities.

Background

  • Texas House of Representatives, District 15, 2019–present (term ends January 2027)
  • Texas House of Representatives, District 15, 2013–2015
  • Ran unsuccessfully for Texas Senate (2014) and U.S. House (2016)
  • Won Republican primary for U.S. House TX-2 on March 3, 2026, defeating incumbent Dan Crenshaw
  • Texas House committees: Appropriations; Corrections; Agriculture and Livestock; Culture, Recreation & Tourism; Criminal Jurisprudence
  • Owner of Acclaim Pools and My PoolXpert; ordained pastor
  • Education: attended Rochester Bible College
  • Born November 29, 1960, in New York; lives in Montgomery County, Texas

Also running for U.S. Representative, District 2

  • Shaun Finnie Democratic
